login.title: RiedChat
login.encryptionNotice: OMEMO encryption is on by default
login.rememberMe: Remember this account on this device
login.passwordHint: The password is stored on the device encrypted (AES-GCM); the key is protected by device biometrics/PIN (WebAuthn) or a separate passphrase.
login.wsUrlMustBeWss: the server address must start with wss:// (unencrypted ws:// is only allowed for localhost)

sidebar.emptyStateHint: Select a contact on the left

modals.clearChatDesc: The entire conversation with «{name}» will be deleted from this device and cannot be recovered. The other person is not affected.
modals.logoutTitle: Log out and delete data from this device?
modals.logoutDescWithJid: The session ({jid}) will be closed. All chat history, media cache and OMEMO keys for this account will be permanently deleted from THIS device. The other person is not affected.
modals.logoutDescNoJid: The session will be closed and local data for this account will be deleted from this device.

security.identityChangedDesc: One of the contact's devices has a new encryption key - this can happen after reinstalling the client, but it can also mean a man-in-the-middle attack. Verify the fingerprint manually if this matters to you.
security.newDeviceDesc: The contact has connected a new device (id {ids}) - messages are now encrypted for it as well. Verify the fingerprint if you want to be sure it's really them.
security.pendingDeviceDesc: The contact has another device (id {ids}), but the limit of remembered keys for them is already reached. Messages from this device won't be decrypted until you replace or remove one of the already remembered keys.

vault.setupDesc: Device biometrics/PIN are unavailable - the saved account will be protected by this passphrase instead. It is never stored anywhere; if you forget it, you'll have to log in again and re-save the account.
vault.unlockDesc: The passphrase that previously protected the saved account on this device is required.

errors.androidBridgeUnavailable: AndroidVaultBridge is unavailable on this device
errors.setupPassphraseRequired: a passphrase is required to set up the vault
errors.webauthnPrfUnsupported: the authenticator does not support the WebAuthn PRF extension
errors.webauthnNoPrfSecret: the authenticator did not return a PRF value
errors.androidBridgeTimeout: android vault bridge: timed out waiting for a response (biometrics/PIN not confirmed?)

common.dbTimeoutFallback: the "{dbName}" database did not open within 8s - it is likely locked by another open tab/window

chatControls.omemoOnTitle: OMEMO is on (click to turn off)
chatControls.omemoOffTitle: OMEMO is off (click to turn on)
chatControls.omemoOnToast: OMEMO turned on - messages will be encrypted
chatControls.omemoOffToast: OMEMO turned off - messages will be sent unencrypted

voiceRecorder.notSupported: audio recording is not supported by this browser
voiceRecorder.chatClosedNotSent: chat is closed - voice message not sent

wallpaper.gifTooLarge: GIF is too large (max 4 MB) - choose a smaller file

videoNote.chatClosedNotSent: chat is closed - video not sent
videoNote.notSupported: video recording is not supported by this browser

stickers.loadFailed: ⚠️ failed to load the sticker pack
stickers.deleteStickerDesc: You won't be able to send it until you upload it again.
stickers.noPacksYet: No packs yet - tap «+» on the left to create the first one.
stickers.nothingToSend: the pack has no stickers - nothing to send
stickers.deletePackConfirmDesc: All stickers inside the pack will be deleted permanently.
stickers.dbTimeout: the sticker database did not open within 8s - it is likely locked by another open tab
stickers.unsupportedFormat: only PNG, WEBP, JPG/JPEG, HEIC and GIF are supported
stickers.tooLarge: the file is too large (max 5 MB) - choose a smaller file

profile.offlineNotice: you're offline - the profile will be sent to contacts on next connection

search.notFoundInView: message not found in the current chat view

select.deleteDesc: The messages will only be deleted on this device - they will remain for the contact and on your other devices.

copyDownload.fileLoading: File is still loading - please wait

fontSettings.invalidExt: a font file is needed: .ttf, .otf, .woff or .woff2
fontSettings.tooLarge: the font file is too large (max 3 MB) - choose a smaller file
fontSettings.appliedSuccess: font uploaded and applied in chat
fontSettings.parseError: failed to parse the font file

files.tooMany: you can only send up to {max} files at once - taking the first {max}

fail.noDevices: No OMEMO devices found for the contact - a call is not possible without encryption.
fail.allDevicesDead: Failed to establish an OMEMO session with any of the contact’s devices.
fail.omemoUnavailable: OMEMO unavailable - a call is not possible without signaling encryption.
fail.sendError: Failed to send the call signal.
fail.alreadyInCall: There is already an active call.
fail.insecureContext: Calls are unavailable: open the page over https:// (or localhost) - otherwise the browser blocks camera/microphone access.

call.contactCallingSomeoneElse: The contact is currently calling someone else
call.contactAlreadyTalking: The contact is already on a call

message.corrupted: message is corrupted and cannot be shown

chatView.downgradeBanner: received unencrypted, though this chat is usually encrypted

fingerprintModal.replaceOneOf: Replace one of the remembered devices
fingerprintModal.pendingReverify: The contact recently changed their encryption key - the fingerprint will reappear here once a new secure session is established with the device.
fingerprintModal.noDevices: No OMEMO devices found for this contact.
fingerprintModal.orphanedTitle: Outdated keys (device no longer used by the contact)
fingerprintModal.openChatFirst: Open a chat with the contact.

upload.largeFileNoE2E: the file is larger than {size} MB - uploading without OMEMO attachment encryption (plain HTTPS link) to avoid overloading tab memory
upload.plainLinkWarning: note: the file is being uploaded via a plain HTTPS link (not OMEMO) - anyone with the link can see it
upload.networkError: the network connection dropped while uploading the file - see details at the bottom of the screen, in the debug log
upload.timeoutError: the upload was interrupted by timeout
upload.slotRejected: the server rejected the slot request
upload.mixedContent: error: the upload server returned an http link while the page is open over https (mixed content) - contact the server administrator
upload.slotLimitReached: the file exceeds the server limit
upload.slotNoResponse: the server did not respond in time (overloaded?) - try again

history.noSpace: not enough space on the device to save chat history - free up some space (e.g. clear the media cache)
history.saveFailed: failed to save {context} on the device: {detail}
history.dbTimeout: the chat history database did not open within 8s - it is likely locked by another open tab/window of this chat
history.dbLocked: chat history won't open: close other tabs/windows with this chat and refresh the page

messaging.newDeviceUndecrypted: {name} has a new device - the message wasn't decrypted, make a decision in the OMEMO menu (⋮)
messaging.editNotFound: Couldn't find the message to edit
messaging.omemoPlaceholder: This message is OMEMO-encrypted - update your client to read it.
messaging.reasonAllDevicesDead: Failed to establish an OMEMO session with any of the contact's devices (keys may have expired).
messaging.reasonNoDevices: No OMEMO devices found for the contact.
messaging.attachmentKeyWarning: {reason} The attachment is encrypted, but the decryption key can only be sent as plain text - the server and anyone intercepting traffic will get access to the file. Send the link with the key unencrypted?
messaging.plaintextWarning: {reason} The {action} can only be sent as plain text. Send it?
messaging.fallbackNoSession: failed to establish an OMEMO session with any of the contact's devices (expired keys?) - sent unencrypted
messaging.fallbackNoDevices: no OMEMO devices found for the contact - sent unencrypted

netRoster.loadFailed: failed to load the contact list

presence.subscribeDesc: Contact {name} ({jid}) wants to see your status (online/offline, last seen time). Allow?

mam.synced: chat history synced with the server (MAM)

connection.loadHistoryFailed: failed to load local chat history: {detail}
connection.omemoReady: OMEMO ready - messages are encrypted by default
connection.connectFailed: failed to connect (check the WebSocket address)
connection.restoreFailedNetwork: failed to restore the connection - check your network
connection.restoreFailedWrongPassword: failed to restore the connection: wrong password
connection.saveAccountFailed: failed to save the account on the device: {detail}
connection.connectionLost: connection lost - please log in again

omemo.notReady: [received an OMEMO-encrypted message, but the encryption module isn't ready]
omemo.pendingDeviceMessage: [message not received: the contact has a new device, the remembered-key limit is reached - open the OMEMO menu (⋮) and make a decision]
omemo.sessionBroken: [failed to decrypt the message: the session is broken or the device was reset]
omemo.integrityFailed: [failed to decrypt the message content: integrity check failed]
omemo.insecureContext: OMEMO unavailable: open the page over https:// (or localhost) - otherwise the browser blocks the Web Crypto API
omemo.libraryNotLoaded: OMEMO unavailable: the encryption library failed to load (network/blockers?)
omemo.publishFailed: keys were created but not published to the server (no PEP?): {detail}
omemo.dbTimeout: the OMEMO key database did not open within 8s - it is likely locked by another open tab/window of this chat
omemo.dbLocked: the OMEMO key storage won't open: close other tabs/windows with this chat and reload the page
